rulings.restated: Enter the amount from helper "Form 1040 line 11b adjusted gross income, but not less than zero".
rulings.model: The IRS line says 'Enter amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b'; the restatement uses a helper that floors line 11b at zero, changing the amount when AGI is negative.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity — amb.2025.sa_medical_negative_agi. The project floors AGI at zero for the medical-expense 7.5% limitation (the recorded reading), and the helper line 2 displays that floored amount. The IRS line says "Enter amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b"; a negative AGI is the registered ambiguity, not a new defect.
